svg.aria-label: Thirteen source databases pass through per-source preparation scripts into derivative CSV tables; GSHP, KSSL, Hohenbrink, Zanjanrood, Arizona, the Canary Islands, the Yellow River Basin, the restricted EU-HYDI, Laikipia, the Andalusian soils and the Australian CSIRO cores (NatSoil and Boorowa) form the default merged reference of 21,546 layers, with UNSODA and sDB added only in the all set.
